title: Living Brain brain event
description: One JSON object per brain turn, nightly-evolve change, MCP call, colony hand-off or operational beat, written by livingbrain-telemetry. Every field is an opaque id, a closed vocabulary word, a number or a null: content is referenced by id and never copied, so no line can carry message text or a page body. The `fields` list below is the same list, in the same order, that `Event::schema()` returns, every vocabulary is the enum's own `as_str()` values, and `crates/livingbrain-telemetry/tests/schema.rs` asserts all three of them — this file, the serialised keys of a real `Event`, and the fixtures in `docs/telemetry/` — against each other on every build, so they cannot drift apart without a failing test. Adding a field, renaming one, retyping one, or adding a variant to a vocabulary is a bump of `version`, never an edit in place.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: The version of this schema. Always the current one.

fields.name: trace_id
fields.description: Opaque id carried across Slack, Worker, MCP and CLI. Non-empty, at most 128 characters, [A-Za-z0-9._:-] only.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What happened. Closed; a new kind is a schema-version bump.

fields.name: at_unix
fields.description: When, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.description: How long it took, in milliseconds. Not bucketed: this line stays on the machine that wrote it.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: { kind, id } — what it was about, by opaque id. Never the content. Null when there was none.

fields.name: error_kind
fields.description: config, upstream, timeout, decode, permission or internal. Null when it did not fail.

fields.name: tool
fields.description: The MCP tool called: brain_search, brain_page or brain_note. Null when no tool was called.

fields.name: colonizer_colony
fields.description: Opaque colony id for a hand-off. Null when this is not a hand-off.
